basic_info.description: Welcome to Arden Residence 1001 - A rare blend of luxury and lifestyle. This exceptional 2 bedroom, 2 bathroom condo offers southeast exposure from this upper floor, an inviting, generous open floor plan featuring a gourmet chef's kitchen with Caesarstone quartz huge island and premium Thermador appliances, floor-to-ceiling windows, separated bedrooms, and in-unit full size washer/dryer. Enjoy tremendous natural light, heating, A/C, top-of-the-line finishes, a spacious balcony, extra storage and an assigned EV parking space. Resort-like amenities include 24/7 doorman, an outdoor 75' lap heated Pool /SPA, fitness, library, lounge, BBQ, expansive outdoor wood deck, and gated parking. A Stellar location, easy access to Oracle Park (Home of the San Francisco Giants) Chase Center (Home of the Golden State Warriors), shopping, restaurants, children's park, dog park, public transportation, MB Shuttle, 101/280 freeways and airports.
